title: Preference Is Not Permission: Personalizing the Auto-Purchase Line in Agentic Commerce
abstract: arXiv:2610.29216v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Personalized shopping benchmarks ask which item fits the user; we ask how far an agent may commit on that item, and pose learning the individual's auto-purchase line as a task. The boundary is evidence-conditioned and three-valued: whether committing is appropriate depends on the sufficiency of product information (warrant), reversibility, price against the user's norm, and urgency, not only on fit; and the natural output is don't buy, confirm first, or buy automatically. Across sixteen instruction-tuned models, autonomous commitment is misaligned with a human authorization reference in which fifteen annotators, role-playing the delegating principal from a given profile, choose the furthest action they would allow without confirmation: models commit even when fit is low and when their own evidence flag reports the warrant missing. translated_title: 偏好不等于许可：代理式商务中个性化自动购买边界的确定
translated_abstract: 个性化购物基准关注的是哪件商品适合用户；我们则提出另一个问题：智能体可以在该商品上被允许承诺到什么程度，并将学习个人的“自动购买线”作为一项任务提出。这条边界以证据为条件且具有三值性：是否做出购买承诺是否恰当，取决于商品信息的充分性（购买依据 warrant）、可逆性、价格是否符合用户的规范以及紧迫性，而不仅仅取决于匹配程度；其自然输出为“不购买”、“先确认”或“自动购买”三个层级。在十六个指令微调模型上的实验表明，模型的自主承诺行为与人类授权参考存在系统性错位——在该参考中，十五名标注者扮演给定用户画像中的委托方，选择他们在无需确认的情况下所允许的最远行动：即便匹配度很低，即便模型自身的证据标志显示购买依据缺失，模型仍会做出购买承诺。这是一种越权行为。这条边界因人而异：这些评分者之间存在分歧，但分歧是结构化的。
tldr: 该论文提出将学习个人化的“自动购买边界”作为代理式商务中的新任务，并发现十六个指令微调模型普遍“越权”——即使商品匹配度低、购买依据缺失也会自动下单，与人类委托者的授权意愿存在系统性错位，且这一边界因人而异、需要个性化建模。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces learning each individual's "auto-purchase line" as a new task in agentic commerce and finds that sixteen instruction-tuned models systematically overreach—auto-committing to purchases even when fit is low or evidence is insufficient—misaligned with human delegators' individualized authorization preferences.
